activity_screen.rule_ar: تُستبعد الشركات النشطة في: الخمور (تصنيعًا وتقطيرًا وتخميرًا وتعبئة ونقلًا وبيعًا وإعادة بيع)؛ التبغ والسجائر الإلكترونية؛ منتجات القنب الترفيهية؛ المنتجات المرتبطة بالخنزير (بما فيها الفنادق والمطاعم والحانات التي تبيع منتجات الخنزير)؛ الخدمات المالية التقليدية (المصرفية والتأمين وخدمات الاستثمار وسمسرة التأمين والتمويل العقاري وغيرها) — باستثناء المؤسسات المالية المصنفة مالية (8000) والمؤسسة كمؤسسة مالية إسلامية، والمؤسسة المالية المتحولة بالكامل إلى الإسلامية متى استوفت شروط الاستثناء الأربعة في الملحق أ؛ تصنيع وتوريد الأسلحة والأنظمة المستخدمة لأغراض غير دفاعية، بما فيها برمجيات التجسس والمكونات والأنظمة الهجومية؛ القمار (الكازينوهات وألعاب المراهنة وألعاب محاكاة القمار وبرمجياته)؛ وترفيه البالغين (الموسيقى والمواد الإباحية والسينما والأفلام والعروض). الشركات العقارية المصنفة (8600) مؤهلة إذا كانت عملياتها وممتلكاتها تدار وفق مبادئ الشريعة. الشركة التي تقل إيراداتها غير المباحة عن 5% من إجمالي إيرادات الأعمال تجتاز فحوص النشاط رغم ذلك (منهجية مؤشرات داو جونز للسوق الإسلامية، نوفمبر 2026، الملحق أ).
activity_screen.rule_en: Companies active in the following are excluded: alcohol (brewers, distillers & vintners, packagers, transporters, sellers and resellers); tobacco and electronic cigarettes; recreational cannabis products; pork-related products (food products, manufacturers, retailers, wholesalers and sellers -- including hotels, restaurants & bars that sell pork products); conventional financial services (banking, insurance, investment services, insurance brokers, mortgage finance, etc.) -- except companies classified Financial (8000) that are incorporated as an Islamic Financial Institution (e.g. Islamic banks, Takaful insurance companies), and except a financial institution transitioning to fully Islamic that meets ALL of the Appendix A conditions (board decision to convert; independent Shariah supervision throughout the transition; the Shariah supervisor, after reviewing and approving the conversion roadmap, approved investment in the company's shares; any new product approved by the Shariah supervisor); manufacture and supply of weapons and systems deployed for purposes other than defense, including spyware and offensive components and systems; gambling (casinos, betting games, gambling simulation games, gambling softwares); and adult entertainment (music, pornography, cinema, movies and shows). Companies classified Real Estate (8600) are eligible if their operations and properties conduct business according to Shariah principles. A company whose non-permissible revenue is below 5% of total business revenue still passes the activity screens (Dow Jones Islamic Market Indices Methodology, November 2026, Appendix A).

basis: Dow Jones Islamic Market Indices Methodology, November 2026 (S&P Dow Jones Indices), Appendix A (Shariah Compliance Screens) and Appendix E (methodology changes): sector-based screens; accounting-based screens as revised effective 2026-09-18 (total interest-bearing debt and cash + interest-bearing securities each below 30% of the trailing 24-month average market capitalisation); dividend purification. Screening is performed for S&P DJI by Ratings Intelligence Partners (RI) under a Shariah Supervisory Board -- the same screener as the S&P Shariah indices. Encoded from S&P DJI's own current methodology document -- supplied by Muhammad on 2026-11-18 after spglobal.com proved unreachable from the build environment -- as issue #169's pin gate requires.
name_ar: منهجية مؤشرات داو جونز للسوق الإسلامية — نوفمبر 2026
name_en: Dow Jones Islamic Market Indices Methodology (November 2026) — S&P Dow Jones Indices
notes: The averaging window is the trailing 24-month average market capitalisation -- NOT the 36-month window the S&P Shariah methodology (and the AAOIFI/MSCI_M avg36m packs) use. The engine resolves it as the avg_market_value_24m aggregate, derived from a market-cap series exactly like the 36-month aggregate, or supplied explicitly by the input pipeline.

Exactly TWO accounting-based ratios exist in the current methodology. History (the document's Appendix E): until March 2023 three ratios at below 33% (including accounts receivable); March 2023 the receivables screen was dropped; September 2023 the cash screen was dropped (leverage-only at 33%); on 2026-09-18 the cash screen was restored and both limits tightened to below 30%. No receivables ratio is encoded.

Buffer / hysteresis: a compliant stock breaching a maximum stays compliant while within 2 percentage points of it, unless breached for 3 consecutive evaluation periods; above the buffer limit it is non-compliant immediately (mirror rule for re-entry). That is index-membership mechanics over successive evaluations; this engine evaluates one statement period point-in-time, so the buffer is recorded per ratio under 'buffers' as methodology metadata and is NOT applied to the verdict -- a documented divergence from index practice, not an encoded threshold.

The transitioning-to-Islamic financial-institution exception, the Financial (8000) Islamic-institution eligibility, and the Real Estate (8600) eligibility note are activity-classification rules: the activity classification is an input to this engine, so they are recorded in the activity screen text and are not encoded as ratios.

The leverage numerator is the methodology's TOTAL interest-bearing debt, which is exactly the data model's interest_bearing_debt field. The cash numerator (cash + interest-bearing securities) is, in this data model, the sum of cash_and_liquid_assets and interest_bearing_assets -- the same composite numerator the MSCI pack encodes.

Total business revenue in the methodology = total operating revenue + all interest income (operating and non-operating); the data model's total_revenue is the input pipeline's corresponding figure, and all interest income sits inside non_compliant_revenue.

capital_component.definition_ar: تعرّف منهجية داو جونز الإسلامية تطهير التوزيعات فقط (نسبة التطهير = التوزيعات × (الدخل غير المباح / إجمالي الدخل))؛ لا تنشر تطهيرًا للأرباح الرأسمالية، فلا يُعلن مكوّن رأسمالي.
capital_component.definition_en: The DJIM methodology defines dividend purification only (Purification ratio = Dividends x (Non-Permissible Income / Total Income)); no capital-gains purification is published, so no capital component is declared.

purification.notes_ar: تطهّر S&P DJI التوزيعات بنسبة الدخل غير المباح: نسبة التطهير = التوزيعات × (الدخل غير المباح / إجمالي الدخل)، حيث الدخل غير المباح = دخل الأنشطة غير المباحة التشغيلي + كل دخل الفوائد (التشغيلي وغير التشغيلي) + دخل الاستثمارات غير المباحة + الدخل غير التشغيلي، وإجمالي الدخل = إجمالي الدخل التشغيلي + كل دخل الفوائد (التشغيلي وغير التشغيلي) + الدخل غير التشغيلي. فحصة التوزيع الواجبة التطهير هي نسبة الدخل غير المتوافق — وهي نسبة التطهير في هذا المعيار. لا تنشر المنهجية قيمة تطهير للسهم الواحد.
purification.notes_en: S&P DJI purifies dividends by the non-permissible share of income: Purification ratio = Dividends x (Non-Permissible Income / Total Income), where non-permissible income = operating business income from non-permissible activities + all interest income (operating and non-operating) + non-permissible investment income + non-operating income, and total income = total operating income + all interest income (operating and non-operating) + non-operating income. The share of a dividend to purify is therefore the non-permissible income ratio -- this rule set's purification ratio. The methodology publishes no per-share purification figure, so per_share_definition is null and no per-share figure is produced.
